experiment: batched greedy MTP heads over a per-session draft-head shortlist
change: An all-greedy MtpHeads round scores proposals through the exact Q4_0 copy of the head: the cycle's first round over the full rows (it seeds each session's exact top-512 plus the gathered Q4_0 rows), later rounds of the same cycle over the gathered 512-row slices (one routed Q4_0 GEMV, token t reading its session's slice). Sampled sessions keep the full Q8 head for exact p/q verification; any candidate request keeps the dense path. A cycle's catch-up invalidates the seed so every cycle re-seeds from its own distribution.
instrument: qwen38_flash_next_gpu_probe --cost-audit 0 --depth 0 (median complete cycle of three warmed samples per width; catch-up/proposal/target phases timed separately; the proposal phase contains the head rounds this change modifies)
protocol: Two interleaved baseline/candidate rounds; baseline = feature/window-native 756eaec built unmodified, candidate = this change. Widths 1-2 and C=1 act as controls (fewer than two head rounds: the shortlist never engages; round-1 rows are dense-path controls).

proposal_phase_ms.note: [baseline r1, baseline r2, candidate r1, candidate r2] - the changed phase drops 50-67%; round-1 rows also drop because the all-greedy dense round now reads the 311 MB Q4_0 head copy instead of the 683 MB Q8_0 head.

quality.c1_pinned_chain: greedy outputs and token SHA traces byte-identical to baseline on three prompts (96 tokens each)
quality.matched_shapes: session_test batched-vs-serial frontier logits, tokens, RNG and acceptance exact at matched widths up to the pre-existing sampled-draw failure (fails identically on baseline); mixed_batch_exact passes
quality.c2_free_running: committed greedy text at C>=2 can flip near-ties when the batch-cycle alignment changes: the UNMODIFIED baseline produces different text for two identical requests staggered 2 s inside one run, so cross-build text differences at C>=2 are engine behavior, not this change
quality.sampled_path: unchanged: any candidate request keeps the exact full Q8 head
quality.pre_existing: --mtp-audit's exact Q8-head candidate comparison predates the Q4_0 draft head and fails identically on baseline; session prefill-chunk check fails identically on baseline

notes: The batch policy learns costs at runtime, so serving widths adapt to the cheaper rounds automatically (no cost-table retune needed).
C2 target_ms also improved ~12% at w8 in both rounds; the audit phases share clock/L2 state, so treat the proposal delta as the mechanism and the total as the headline.
